intro: Mental health and substance abuse social workers read people deeply and coordinate complex care, skills that therapy and counseling careers share. The closest of the 25 careers below is advanced practice psychiatric nursing, with an 89% match, while Occupational Therapists are 84% matched and earn a BLS May 2025 median of $100,330, or 66% more.
why_it_works: Supporting clients through addiction or mental illness means building trust, planning treatment and connecting them with services. O*NET rates social perceptiveness at 4.25 out of 5 for this job, and coordination, problem solving and service orientation at 3.88. Therapy, teaching and counseling roles use the same skills. 20 of the 25 matches pay more, though many need their own license.
tips: Speech-Language Pathologists earn $97,870, which is 62% more, after a graduate program.
Teaching social work at a college pays $77,570, or 29% more.

faq.q: What jobs can former mental health social workers do?
faq.a: The closest matches are advanced practice psychiatric nurses (89%), clinical nurse specialists (84%) and Occupational Therapists (84%), based on O*NET 31.0. Recreational Therapists are 83% matched and earn $61,960, which is 3% more than the $60,280 median for this job.

faq.q: Which careers for mental health social workers pay more?
faq.a: 20 of the 25 matches pay more. Occupational Therapists earn $100,330 (66% more), Genetic Counselors $100,040 (66% more) and Speech-Language Pathologists $97,870 (62% more), according to BLS May 2025 data. Each requires its own graduate program and license.

faq.q: Do mental health social workers need another degree?
faq.a: Not more education in general: all 25 matches need no more than these social workers already have. A master's degree is common, held by 87% of workers in the closest match, but each therapy career needs a degree in its own field.

faq.q: What skills should mental health social workers build?
faq.a: The skills that most often need work are instructing, troubleshooting, judgment and decision making and operations analysis. Coordination already rates 3.88 out of 5 for this job in O*NET, so teaching skills and clinical decision making are the main steps for most moves.
